title: 2.1.38 Challenges: Optional Stretch
sourceRef: designed: stretch practice drawing on every book 2.1 concept (if/else if/else, truthy/falsy, ternary, &&/||/!)

steps.title: Leap year checker
steps.instructions: Create a variable called year. Write a condition that logs 'Leap year' when the year is divisible by 4 and (not divisible by 100, or divisible by 400), and 'Not a leap year' otherwise. You will need &&, ||, and !.

steps.title: Rock-paper-scissors winner
steps.instructions: Create playerOne and playerTwo, each set to 'rock', 'paper', or 'scissors'. Use an else if chain to log which player wins, or 'Tie' if they match.

steps.title: Nested shipping rule
steps.instructions: Create isMember and orderTotal. Nest an if inside an if: if isMember, then check orderTotal: free shipping at $35 or more, otherwise a $5 fee. If not a member, free shipping only at $75 or more, otherwise a $10 fee.
